title: Installed native DTMF signed service delivery and SDK submission
scope: Isolated local macOS arm64 production Store/service/Core/server and public Rust SDK over signed native QUIC. Named signal grants and local test endpoints are explicit. Five new production cases are qualified; this is not all DTMF fault/profile vectors or full G6-046.
implementation: Physical DTMF registration/mux retained by actual recipient handler; runtime registry uses weak metadata references.

Managed signed source observation freezes current permitted recipients in Store under original proof. Handler returns Preparing; worker releases its copy of original invocation before downstream work.

Every actual signed native writer validates source/recipient/intent/frame, fresh named Store grants and Core original/current audience; reserves frame then acquires bounded actual IO lease. Closed flight admission waits all owned leases stopped before local fact settlement.
SDK send_native_dtmf uses request_value; inspected request_value preserves unsolicited DTMF via queue_event, and owned reader never coalesces DTMF.
New actual production tests cover both algorithms, original replay, missing named receive permission and local writer fact storage failure. New Store selection test added.

Current named recipient selection uses the already-held complete source invocation interval, excludes unpermitted original recipients and freezes no facts or idle readers during selection. Default credential scopes are unchanged.

Canonical operation.updated now carries stored problem details. HTTP DtmfSend explicitly refuses borrowing a physical native source before any operation admission. Canonical OpenAPI documents the native boundary and shared operation-status path.

Recipient jobs close admission and wait for all actual write leases to be destroyed before recording a local fact. Actual signed frame ID, source received_at and actual-native provenance match journaled results. No remote playback is asserted.

cases: Actual signed EdDSA and ES256 source-to-recipient SDK delivery, exact digits/method intent, per-frame local result, original completed replay without another effect, conflicting valid altered digits refused.
Another SDK command preserves queued incoming DTMF; payload source and observation claims cannot replace actual native source/received_at/source-envelope identity.
Existing audio/subscription grant without named dtmf.receive cannot receive and fails before any source or recipient delivery fact.
Injected local writer-fact storage failure leaves preparation and no partial journal fact; removing it records the same actually received frame without redelivery.
Actual HTTP request cannot supply native source custody and creates no operation record.
